North Carolina election contest details
Contest:
NOTE:
For some counties, based on the way they prepare their ballots, precinct maps and data charts on this site include results of voters who cast ballots in those precincts on Election Day only. In those counties, votes of early voters, absentee-by-mail voters, and provisional voters are reported in separate “administrative” precincts. After the election, county boards of elections sort these ballots into the voters’ precincts and report full precinct results through the “precinct sort.” For precinct sort data, see
Historical Election Results Data
.
